texts: On day 540 of Year 2, the moon was full.
The Council convened at the Watch.
Sailsworn reported to the Council that the salt-bloom store held twelve weeks of supply.
Tessa Brae reported to the Council that the feather store held five weeks of supply.
The Council continued the doubled feather ration at the Stilllight Station through the spring.
The Council asked the apprentices to collect feathers more thoroughly in the molting season.
Hesper reported to the Council that the mire-essence reserve held eight months of supply.
Hesper said that a strong summer thread harvest would restore the reserve.

q1_issues.issue: "twelve weeks of supply" is stored as (Measure sk_supply_1 duration 12 week), but no word in the clause supplies the dimension "duration" — the instruction set uses that scale only for an eventuality's own extent and requires the reserved symbol `unspecified` when no word supplies a dimension (same at 26 and 55).

q2_gaps: a stock quantified as time-to-exhaustion ("twelve weeks of supply", "eight months of supply") — a measure of-phrase over a bare mass noun with a time unit is explicitly excluded from Possession but given no positive encoding, so neither the scale nor the bearer is licensed
elided-standard adverbial comparative ("collect feathers more thoroughly") — no standard to fill More's second slot, so the manner content has no licensed carrier and is dropped
a spanning temporal PP ("through the spring") — no licensed head for an extent running through a named period; During is restricted to during/while/throughout, leaving only a bare End
a bare season noun ("the spring") — the Time section forms season constants only in deictic shapes (last_spring / next_summer) and offers no structured term for a plain season
review.notes: The instruction set does not settle whether an object-control verb's object ("asked the apprentices to collect") also takes a matrix role; the parse gives the apprentices only the embedded Agent, which the causative bullet's "the object lives only in the caused event" supports. Everything else is handled correctly — non-factive reports sealed under Theme with definite stores and their compound genus projected, the indefinite harvest kept inside the seal, embedded "would" as Future inside the seal, "the Council"/"the Watch" as Name-less capitalized common nouns, and "the reserve" resolved to the earlier mire-essence reserve.

issues.reason: Measures & units states that a scale no word supplies is never invented and that an unstated dimension takes the reserved symbol `unspecified`, and the `duration` scale is licensed only for an eventuality's own extent ("for three hours", "lasted two days"), never for an entity witness like sk_supply_1, so `duration` is an invented scale at 18, 26 and 55.

gaps_confirmed: stock expressed as time-to-exhaustion ("twelve weeks of supply", "eight months of supply") — a measure phrase whose unit is time but whose dimension is stock has no licensed scale and no licensed bearer; the `unspecified` fallback is available but erases the reading

elided-standard adverbial comparative ("collect feathers more thoroughly") — nothing fills More's second slot, so the manner content has no carrier and must be dropped (the instruction set names this gap itself)
a spanning temporal PP ("through the spring") — `During` is restricted to during/while/throughout, so an extent running through a named period has no licensed head and only a bare `End` is reachable
a bare season noun ("the spring") — the Time section forms seasons only as deictic constants (last_spring / next_summer) and offers no structured term for a plain season
new_gaps: a day-ordinal within a year ("on day 540 of Year 2") — `(Day <n>)` is the day-of-month slot, so `(Day 540)` beside `(Year 2)` overloads it and cannot feed the seeded same-year-month day ordering; no term exists for a day-of-year count or a regnal-style year

an object-control COMMUNICATION verb ("asked the apprentices to collect") — the control bullet copies the controller into the embedded event and the causative bullet bars a matrix role for the object, so the addressee of `ask` gets no `Recipient`; "whom did the Council ask?" has nothing to bind, and a licensed form would need to carry the addressee on the matrix verb as well as the controller role
adjudication.defect_summary: The three sealed report measures should carry the reserved scale symbol — (Measure sk_supply_1 unspecified 12 week), (Measure sk_supply_2 unspecified 5 week), (Measure sk_supply_3 unspecified 8 month) — since `week` / `month` are stated but no word supplies a dimension; note that this compliant form records nothing about what the weeks measure, and no licensed form carries the time-to-exhaustion reading at all (first gap above).
adjudication.notes: Everything else holds up: report/say sealed non-factively with `Experiencer` holders and `Recipient` addressees, definite store typings and their compound genus atoms projected out of the seals, embedded "would" as `Future` inside the seal, the copular time-modifier dual-emit on the full moon, and "the Council" / "the Watch" kept Name-less as capitalized common nouns. The elided comparative was correctly dropped rather than mis-slotted as `Manner`.
